display_name: Maria, betrothed of Isaiah of Peking

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιουνίου, «Μαρία η νύφη του», with the rank word left off; the page's head calls her «Αγια Μαρια η Νυφη Του Μητροφανη».

birth.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγια Μαρια η Νυφη Του Μητροφανη (1881 - 1900)»; the narrative says she was nineteen years old.

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγια Μαρια η Νυφη Του Μητροφανη (1881 - 1900)», and the account places the killing on the night after 10 June 1900.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026). saint.gr places her in the household of a priest of the Russian mission at Peking, so a Russian row is very likely to exist; it was not looked for and nothing is claimed about it.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Μητροφάνης Τσί-Σούνγκ και οι μαζί μ' αυτόν μαρτυρήσαντες: … Μαρία η νύφη του …»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and dates her «(1881 - 1900)». The day's line and the page's head both call her «η νύφη του», Metrophanes's daughter-in-law or bride, while the narrative calls her «Η Μαρία, αρραβωνιαστικιά του Ησαϊα» — the betrothed of Isaiah, his son — and she is recorded here as that, on the page's own narrative. The entry enumerates its members, so she is a folder of her own. None of the page's hymns names her. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
